name: clip
summary: 4 key moments: ready -> right kick extended -> right leg lowered -> right kick extended -> standing stance -> finish
action: Performs two extended right-leg side kicks with a return to standing between them.

stages.name: right kick extended
stages.description: Lifts the right leg forward and up into a high extended kick while balancing on the left leg.
stages.measured: right foot up, right foot forward

stages.name: right leg lowered
stages.description: Lowers the right leg back down to return to a standing position.
stages.measured: right foot down, right foot left

stages.name: right kick extended
stages.description: Lifts the right leg up and out to the side into another high extended kick.
stages.measured: right foot up, right foot right

stages.name: standing stance
stages.description: Lowers the right leg back down to return to a standing position.
stages.measured: right foot down, right foot back

notes: Progress toward the next key moment pays as it happens, gated on staying upright.
Each key moment reached pays a bonus; a jump pays extra for its height.
Finishing pays a bonus scaled by the moments reached.
Once done, holding the end pose pays per second, and the style terms stop.
A fall gives back what the attempt earned since the last steady stance.
Timing is free: only the order of the moments counts.
Optional moments pay too, but may be skipped.
